tha-ap50:1.1: Caṅkamadāyaka.] *Atthadassissa munino* lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / iṭṭhakāhi cinitvāna caṅkamaṃ kārayim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap50:2.1: Uccato pañcaratanaṃ caṅkamaṃ sādhu māpitaṃ / āyāmato hatthasataṃ bhāvanīyaṃ manoramaṃ. // //
tha-ap50:3.1: Paṭiggahesi bhagavā Atthadassī naruttamo / hatthena puḷinaṃ gayha imā gāthā abhāsathā: // //
tha-ap50:4.1: ‘Imina puḷinadānena caṅkamaṃ sukatena ca / sattaratanasampannaṃ puḷinaṃ anubhossati. // //
tha-ap50:5.1: Tīṇi kappāni devesu devarajjaṃ karissati / anubhossati sampattiṃ accharāhi purakkhato. // //
tha-ap50:6.1: Manussalokaṃ āgantvā rājā raṭṭhe bhavissati / tikkhattuñ cakkavattī ca mahiyā so bhavissati.' // //
tha-ap50:7.1: Aṭṭhārase kappasate yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi caṅkamassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap50:8.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sasanan
tha-ap50:9.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Caṅkamadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
